title: U-14 Girls Win CISCE Zonal Kabaddi
body:
CISCE Zonal Level Kabaddi Competition 2026 held at Swami Vivekanand School, Chandapura on July 1st and 2nd July, U-14 girls secured 1st place and 6 students from Lawrence school selected for the regional level.

Amritha E of grade 7 F is awarded Best defender Award.

photos.alt: U-14 girls kabaddi team with their zonal medals
